key_insight: Plasticity-preserving methods improve deep RL robustness on harder tasks as observation noise increases, but extreme stochasticity shifts the main failure mode to TD instability.
engineering_relevance: For noisy control systems, evaluate plasticity interventions alongside TD stability rather than assuming that preserving plasticity alone ensures reliable learning.
method: Train SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks.
Vary controlled levels of observation and action noise.
Compare plasticity-preserving methods, including resets and resets combined with layer normalization.
evidence_signal: Across the three tasks, robustness gains appeared on the two harder tasks and grew with observation noise; resets combined with layer normalization underperformed resets alone at every observation-noise level tested.
watch_item: Effects depend on task difficulty: noise can sustain plasticity in easier settings, so intervention benefits should not be assumed to generalize beyond the tested tasks.
paper_title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
